note: Labels are frozen clean-source energy approximations, never candidate VAD output; not human-annotated truth, P.56, LUFS, or natural whisper/shout. Source native pauses remain in content, excluded only from primary active metrics. Source files are not modified. Five clips comprise about four speakers; the two LJ clips share Linda Johnson.
label_method: 10ms RMS >= source 95th percentile minus 20 dB; bridge <=60ms holes and expand both ends by20ms. Also frozen -15/-25/-30dB masks for sensitivity.
